recommendation_summary: The reply recommends setting up a hosted Healthchecks.io dead man's switch: `nightly-sync` pings it on success (plus a `/fail` ping from its exception handler), and the service alerts the user if the daily ping doesn't arrive.
note: The reply recommends one off-site heartbeat alert, explicitly turns down the self-hosted Synology/Docker version, puts the central log off as a separate later project, and has none of the four labelled record lines.
